prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow character</title>
<style>
html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #fffefd; }
canvas { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 244;
const height = 240;
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffefd);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
  preserveDrawingBuffer: true,
  antialias: true
});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
renderer.setClearColor(0xfffefd, 1);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122, 122, 120, -120, 1, 1100);
ref.position.set(0, 0, 500);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
ref.layers.enable(1);

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(244, 240),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    depthWrite: false,
    vertexShader: `
      void main() { gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      void main() {
        vec2 p = vec2(gl_FragCoord.x, 240.0 - gl_FragCoord.y);
        float floorFade = smoothstep(199.0, 242.0, p.y);
        float edge = smoothstep(32.0, 122.0, abs(p.x - 122.0));
        float grain = fract(sin(dot(floor(p), vec2(37.17, 71.53))) * 4183.17) - .5;
        vec3 white = vec3(1.0, .996, .988);
        vec3 floorColor = vec3(.78, .765, .76) - edge * vec3(.091, .072, .046);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(white, floorColor, floorFade * .93) + grain * .024 * floorFade, 1.0);
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'white-background-and-floor';
backdrop.position.z = -225;
backdrop.layers.set(1);
backdrop.renderOrder = -1;
scene.add(backdrop);

const world = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x - 122, 120 - y, z);
const clamp = (v, lo = 0, hi = 1) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
const smooth = (a, b, x) => {
  const u = clamp((x - a) / (b - a));
  return u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
};
const gaussian = (x, y, sx, sy) => Math.exp(-((x / sx) ** 2 + (y / sy) ** 2));
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const palette = rows => rows.map(([at, hex]) => [at, color(hex)]);

function shadeAt(stops, value) {
  for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) {
    if (value <= stops[i][0]) {
      const [a, ca] = stops[i - 1];
      const [b, cb] = stops[i];
      return ca.clone().lerp(cb, smooth(a, b, value));
    }
  }
  return stops[stops.length - 1][1].clone();
}

function group(parent, name, position = new THREE.Vector3()) {
  const node = new THREE.Group();
  node.name = name;
  node.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(node);
  return node;
}

const character = group(scene, 'character-yellow');
const torso = group(character, 'torso');
const head = group(character, 'head', world(124, 69, 0));
const eyes = group(head, 'eyes');
const mouth = group(head, 'mouth', world(123, 47, 36).sub(head.position));

function surfaceMaterial(grain, transparent = false) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    vertexColors: true,
    transparent,
    depthWrite: !transparent,
    uniforms: { grainAmount: { value: grain } },
    vertexShader: `
      attribute float opacity;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vPoint;
      varying vec3 vTint;
      varying float vOpacity;
      void main() {
        vPoint = position;
        vNormal = mat3(modelMatrix) * normal;
        vTint = color;
        vOpacity = opacity;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform float grainAmount;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vPoint;
      varying vec3 vTint;
      varying float vOpacity;
      float hash(vec3 p) {
        p = fract(p * vec3(.1031, .1030, .0973));
        p += dot(p, p.yxz + 33.33);
        return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
      }
      void main() {
        vec3 n = normalize(vNormal);
        float key = dot(n, normalize(vec3(-.30, .68, .88))) * .5 + .5;
        float fill = dot(n, normalize(vec3(.71, .42, -.81))) * .5 + .5;
        float lower = dot(n, normalize(vec3(.18, -.93, .32))) * .5 + .5;
        float light = .60 + .38 * key + .12 * fill + .047 * lower;
        float noise = hash(floor(vPoint * vec3(1.5, 1.5, 1.7))) - .5;
        float dither = hash(vec3(floor(gl_FragCoord.xy), 17.0)) - .5;
        vec3 rgb = vTint * (light + grainAmount * noise) * vec3(1.02, 1.0, .974);
        rgb += dither * grainAmount * .043;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(max(rgb, vec3(0.0)), vOpacity);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  });
}

const skin = surfaceMaterial(.072);
const handsMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.106);
const eyeMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.015);
const mouthMaterial = surfaceMaterial(.038, true);

function addMesh(parent, name, material, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices) {
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('opacity', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(opacity, 1));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

// Each section records image height, left edge, right edge, depth center, and depth radius.
const bodyProfile = [
  [-6, 124, 124, -1, .02],
  [-3, 108, 142, -1, 14],
  [ 2,  99, 149, -1, 23],
  [11,  93, 155, -1, 30],
  [23,  88, 159, -1, 36],
  [36,  85, 164, -2, 40],
  [51,  79, 173, -3, 43],
  [65,  70, 185, -4, 46],
  [81,  62, 195, -5, 49],
  [103, 56, 200, -6, 54],
  [128, 49, 204, -7, 59],
  [151, 44, 210, -8, 63],
  [173, 39, 214, -9, 66],
  [194, 35, 217, -10, 68],
  [212, 35, 215, -10, 66],
  [228, 39, 211, -10, 61],
  [242, 45, 205, -10, 54],
  [254, 56, 195, -10, 45],
  [265, 78, 174, -10, 32],
  [271, 103, 149, -10, 17],
  [273, 126, 126, -10, .02]
];

function section(profile, y) {
  const last = profile.length - 1;
  if (y <= profile[0][0]) return profile[0].slice(1);
  if (y >= profile[last][0]) return profile[last].slice(1);
  let i = 0;
  while (y > profile[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = profile[i];
  const b = profile[i + 1];
  const before = profile[Math.max(i - 1, 0)];
  const after = profile[Math.min(i + 2, last)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = (y - a[0]) / span;
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  const result = [];
  for (let k = 1; k < a.length; k++) {
    const m0 = span * (b[k] - before[k]) / (b[0] - before[0]);
    const m1 = span * (after[k] - a[k]) / (after[0] - a[0]);
    result.push((2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * a[k] +
      (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * m0 + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[k] +
      (t3 - t2) * m1);
  }
  return result;
}

function crossSection(profile, y, angle, sculpt) {
  const [left, right, zCenter, depth] = section(profile, y);
  const front = Math.cos(angle);
  const x = (left + right) * .5 + Math.max(.015, (right - left) * .5) * Math.sin(angle);
  const z = zCenter + Math.max(.015, depth) * front + sculpt(x, y, front);
  return world(x, y, z);
}

function makeShell(parent, name, profile, first, last, material, tint, sculpt = () => 0) {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], opacity = [], indices = [];
  const slices = 104;
  const rows = Math.ceil((last - first) / .95);
  const origin = parent.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const point = (y, a) => crossSection(profile, y, a, sculpt);
  for (let row = 0; row <= rows; row++) {
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(first, last, row / rows);
    for (let j = 0; j <= slices; j++) {
      const angle = 2 * Math.PI * j / slices;
      const p = point(y, angle);
      const dy = point(y + .06, angle).sub(point(y - .06, angle));
      const da = point(y, angle + .003).sub(point(y, angle - .003));
      const normal = dy.cross(da).normalize();
      const c = tint(p.x + 122, y, Math.cos(angle));
      positions.push(p.x - origin.x, p.y - origin.y, p.z - origin.z);
      normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      opacity.push(1);
      if (row < rows && j < slices) {
        const a = row * (slices + 1) + j;
        const b = a + slices + 1;
        indices.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return addMesh(parent, name, material, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices);
}

const coat = palette([
  [-6, 0xffeda5], [13, 0xf7e480], [32, 0xf4d45d],
  [52, 0xf3cb51], [75, 0xffd972], [111, 0xecbd59],
  [152, 0xe6b66c], [189, 0xd6ab62], [220, 0xc9a052],
  [248, 0xbc9045], [273, 0xb58b42]
]);
const breast = palette([
  [69, 0xffdb83], [99, 0xffe0a2], [130, 0xffe3b2],
  [160, 0xffdeb0], [185, 0xfad3a0], [209, 0xe9bd7b],
  [236, 0xd2a65b], [263, 0xc39a4d]
]);
const contact = color(0x9e6c22);
const lidWarmth = color(0xa28932);
const muzzleLight = color(0xffe68b);

function bodySculpt(x, y, front) {
  const f = Math.max(0, front);
  return f * f * (3.8 * gaussian(x - 123, y - 44, 20, 15) +
    2.7 * gaussian(x - 130, y - 151, 50, 58));
}

function bodyTint(x, y, front) {
  const c = shadeAt(coat, y);
  const facing = smooth(.18, .81, front);
  const bellyWidth = 50 + 19 * smooth(75, 163, y);
  const bellyX = (x - 128) / bellyWidth;
  const bellyY = (y - 151) / 77;
  const bellySize = Math.sqrt(bellyX * bellyX + bellyY * bellyY);
  const belly = (1 - smooth(.49, 1.16, bellySize)) * facing;
  c.lerp(shadeAt(breast, y), belly * .96);
  const underArms = .30 * gaussian(x - 63, y - 142, 16, 27) +
    .38 * gaussian(x - 193, y - 116, 19, 32);
  c.lerp(contact, underArms * smooth(-.14, .53, front));
  const eyelids = .48 * gaussian(x - 102, y - 25.5, 8.4, 9.0) +
    .53 * gaussian(x - 145, y - 20.5, 8.3, 8.3);
  c.lerp(lidWarmth, eyelids * facing);
  c.lerp(muzzleLight, .62 * facing * gaussian(x - 121, y - 34.8, 18, 5.2));
  return c;
}

makeShell(torso, 'pear-shaped-body', bodyProfile, 69, 273, skin, bodyTint, bodySculpt);
makeShell(head, 'rounded-head', bodyProfile, -6, 69, skin, bodyTint, bodySculpt);

function faceZ(x, y) {
  const [left, right] = section(bodyProfile, y);
  const sine = clamp((2 * x - left - right) / (right - left), -.999, .999);
  return crossSection(bodyProfile, y, Math.asin(sine), bodySculpt).z;
}

function faceNormal(x, y) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(
    faceZ(x - .1, y) - faceZ(x + .1, y),
    faceZ(x, y + .1) - faceZ(x, y - .1),
    .2
  ).normalize();
}

function makeMouth() {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], opacity = [], indices = [];
  const origin = mouth.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const inner = color(0xdc9637);
  const edge = color(0xe8a840);
  const lower = color(0xd98d32);
  const rim = color(0xffd36c);
  const rings = 26, steps = 84;
  for (let i = 0; i <= rings; i++) {
    const r = Math.max(.001, i / rings);
    for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
      const a = 2 * Math.PI * j / steps;
      const q = Math.cos(a) * r;
      const x = 122.6 + 23.2 * q;
      const y = 49.0 + Math.sin(a) * r * (Math.sin(a) < 0 ? 10.8 : 14.4) - 2.75 * q * q - 1.1 * q;
      const n = faceNormal(x, y);
      const p = world(x, y, faceZ(x, y) + .27 + .86 * (1 - r * r)).sub(origin);
      const c = inner.clone().lerp(edge, r * .72);
      c.lerp(lower, .53 * gaussian(x - 121, y - 47, 17, 6.7));
      c.lerp(rim, .49 * gaussian(x - 120, y - 56, 16, 7));
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      normals.push(n.x, n.y, n.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      opacity.push(.84 * (1 - smooth(.48, 1, r)));
      if (i < rings && j < steps) {
        const k = i * (steps + 1) + j;
        const next = k + steps + 1;
        indices.push(k, k + 1, next, k + 1, next + 1, next);
      }
    }
  }
  addMesh(mouth, 'soft-orange-mouth', mouthMaterial, positions, normals, colors, opacity, indices);
}
makeMouth();

function ellipsoid(parent, name, radius, material, tint) {
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 42, 30);
  const positions = geo.attributes.position;
  const rgb = [];
  const alpha = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
    const c = tint(positions.getX(i), positions.getY(i), positions.getZ(i));
    rgb.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    alpha.push(1);
  }
  geo.scale(...radius);
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('opacity', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(alpha, 1));
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const blackOlive = color(0x22240f);
const eyeEdge = color(0x4a481c);
const eyeGlint = color(0x877747);

function makeEye(name, x, y, rx, ry) {
  const n = faceNormal(x, y);
  const position = world(x, y, faceZ(x, y)).addScaledVector(n, -.46).sub(head.position);
  const eye = group(eyes, name, position);
  eye.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), n);
  ellipsoid(eye, 'dark-eye', [rx, ry, 2.65], eyeMaterial, (u, v, w) => {
    const c = blackOlive.clone().lerp(eyeEdge, .54 * (1 - smooth(.06, .85, w)));
    c.lerp(eyeGlint, .30 * gaussian(u + .24, v - .44, .28, .22) * Math.max(0, w));
    return c;
  });
}
makeEye('eye-on-image-left', 102.5, 25.5, 4.95, 5.65);
makeEye('eye-on-image-right', 145.1, 20.7, 5.2, 5.8);

const leftArmProfile = [
  [83, 70, 70, 37, .02],
  [90, 61, 79, 42, 9],
  [101, 50, 84, 42, 15],
  [113, 42, 88, 39, 20],
  [127, 37, 85, 35, 23],
  [139, 39, 80, 33, 21],
  [150, 45, 75, 30, 16],
  [157, 52, 67, 28, 9],
  [160, 60, 60, 27, .02]
];
const rightArmProfile = [
  [75, 209, 209, 44, .02],
  [83, 200, 219, 45, 11],
  [96, 194, 222, 43, 15],
  [109, 192, 228, 39, 20],
  [123, 194, 232, 33, 22],
  [135, 198, 229, 31, 19],
  [144, 204, 222, 28, 12],
  [150, 213, 213, 25, .02]
];
const leftHandProfile = [
  [72.5, 69, 69, 51, .02],
  [75, 63, 75, 52, 6],
  [80, 57, 80, 53, 10],
  [87, 53.5, 84, 53, 13],
  [94, 55, 87, 51, 13],
  [101, 61, 88, 49, 11],
  [108, 70, 87, 46, 8],
  [112, 80, 80, 43, .02]
];
const rightHandProfile = [
  [60.5, 212, 212, 52, .02],
  [64, 208, 217, 53, 5],
  [69, 205, 222, 54, 9],
  [76, 201, 225.5, 54, 11],
  [83, 198, 225, 52, 12],
  [90, 196.5, 220, 49, 11],
  [97, 198, 214, 46, 7],
  [102, 204, 204, 44, .02]
];

const armCoat = palette([
  [75, 0xe7b049], [96, 0xf9cc60], [110, 0xf9c755],
  [124, 0xf0ad3d], [137, 0xe5a039], [151, 0xca862a],
  [161, 0xbb7829]
]);
const armGoldenLight = color(0xffd981);
const armShadow = color(0xbd7928);
const pawCoat = palette([
  [60, 0x7e6e4b], [73, 0x696044], [84, 0x594b2e],
  [96, 0x514022], [107, 0x67512d], [113, 0x93703a]
]);
const pawRim = color(0x91784c);
const pawFold = color(0x3b3322);
const wrist = color(0xc08e40);

function armTint(side, x, y, front) {
  const base = shadeAt(armCoat, y + (side === 'right' ? 3 : 0));
  const center = side === 'left' ? 53 : 218;
  base.lerp(armGoldenLight, .37 * gaussian(x - center, y - 111, 18, 19) * smooth(.02, .89, front));
  const inner = side === 'left' ? 79 : 198;
  base.lerp(armShadow, .37 * gaussian(x - inner, y - 128, 12, 21));
  return base;
}

function pawTint(side, x, y, front) {
  const left = side === 'left';
  const c = shadeAt(pawCoat, y + (left ? -2 : 5));
  const sheen = left ? gaussian(x - 63, y - 81, 7.5, 9) : gaussian(x - 210, y - 72, 7, 8);
  c.lerp(pawRim, .51 * sheen);
  const crossing = left ? x - (67 + .45 * (y - 87)) : y - (88 - .33 * (x - 206));
  const fold = left ? gaussian(crossing, y - 91, 2.5, 11) : gaussian(crossing, x - 208, 1.65, 10);
  c.lerp(pawFold, .36 * fold * smooth(.15, .9, front));
  const lowerEdge = left ? 105.1 + .28 * (x - 77) : 96 - .28 * (x - 205);
  c.lerp(wrist, .83 * smooth(lowerEdge - 1, lowerEdge + 6, y));
  return c;
}

function makeArm(side, armProfile, handProfile, shoulder, cuff) {
  const arm = group(torso, 'arm-on-image-' + side, world(...shoulder));
  const hand = group(arm, 'hand-on-image-' + side, world(...cuff).sub(arm.position));
  makeShell(arm, 'rounded-yellow-arm', armProfile, armProfile[0][0],
    armProfile[armProfile.length - 1][0], skin, (x, y, f) => armTint(side, x, y, f));
  makeShell(hand, 'dark-mitten-shaped-hand', handProfile, handProfile[0][0],
    handProfile[handProfile.length - 1][0], handsMaterial, (x, y, f) => pawTint(side, x, y, f));
}
makeArm('left', leftArmProfile, leftHandProfile, [71, 121, 27], [73, 103, 48]);
makeArm('right', rightArmProfile, rightHandProfile, [191, 116, 27], [206, 95, 45]);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [character], render, ready: true };
</script>
